As of my last update in 2023, Judah Lewis is an actor who first gained notable attention through his role in the 2015 film "Demolition," where he co-starred alongside Jake Gyllenhaal. Born on May 22, 2001, in the United States, Lewis started acting at a young age.

Judah Lewis came to greater prominence through his role in the Netflix horror-comedy film series "The Babysitter." He starred as Cole Johnson in "The Babysitter" (2017) and reprised his role in its sequel "The Babysitter: Killer Queen" (2020). These films were directed by McG and became popular among viewers for their blend of horror, comedy, and action elements. His performance in these films was well-received, and he became known for his comedic timing as well as his ability to handle more intense scenes.

He has also appeared in other films such as "The Christmas Chronicles" (2018) and its sequel "The Christmas Chronicles 2" (2020), where he played the character Teddy Pierce alongside actors like Kurt Russell and Goldie Hawn. These family-friendly movies were also successful on Netflix and contributed to his rising fame.

In addition to films, Judah Lewis has made appearances in television series. Before his film debut, he was seen in episodes of series like "CSI: Cyber."

Lewis's acting career began with auditions around 2014, and he was considered for the role of Spider-Man in the Marvel Cinematic Universe during the casting for "Captain America: Civil War," a role which eventually went to Tom Holland.

As an actor emerging in Hollywood, Judah Lewis continues to develop his career by taking on diverse roles that showcase his range and depth as a performer. Beyond his professional life, there is limited publicly available detailed personal information, as he tends to keep his personal life private.
